# StudyWeb

> StudyWeb is an AI-powered personalized Socratic learning platform that transforms confusion into conceptual clarity. Built by educators for students (grades 6-12+), it guides learners through step-by-step Socratic questioning rather than giving away homework answers, fostering genuine problem-solving, critical thinking, and academic confidence.

StudyWeb provides intelligent tutoring, revision accelerators, parent & teacher oversight dashboards, and interactive active-learning tools. Early pre-registration grants 50% off the first month of membership.

## Core Features

- **Socratic Pedagogy Engine**: Instead of outputting direct homework solutions, the AI asks targeted Socratic guiding questions that steer the student toward independent breakthrough.
- **Cognitive Acceleration**: Helps students learn faster, revise smarter, save hours on test prep, and improve overall academic grades.
- **Safety & Trust Filtered**: Sandboxed, age-appropriate AI models strictly focused on academic curriculum (STEM, Humanities, Languages) with zero off-topic or inappropriate responses.
- **Student Privacy Guaranteed**: Strict data confidentiality. Never sells student data or injects ads. Parents and educators receive high-level progress analytics without reading private study chats.
- **Pre-Launch Early Access**: Waitlist members receive an exclusive 50% discount on their first month of membership upon public launch.

## Key Information

- **Target Audience**: Middle school, high school, and college students (ages 12-18+), parents, and educators.
- **Subjects Covered**: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, History, Literature, Computer Science, and General Studies.
- **Access Model**: Web application with responsive mobile, tablet, and desktop interfaces.
- **Pricing & Offer**: Free early waitlist registration with 50% discount on the first month upon release.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does StudyWeb protect student privacy?
We take privacy seriously. We only gather data explicitly required for personalized learning and performance tracking. We will never sell student data or use it for third-party advertising, ensuring a purely educational environment.

### Is the AI tutor safe and appropriate for all students?
Our AI models are rigorously safety-filtered, sandboxed securely, and fine-tuned specifically for academic subjects aged 12-18. The AI is proactively restricted from engaging in off-topic, harmful, or non-educational conversations.

### Will StudyWeb just do my homework for me?
No. StudyWeb is an educational tool built for conceptual mastery, not academic dishonesty. The AI is explicitly programmed to act as a supportive instructor—guiding students to answers via Socratic questioning rather than simply giving away the solutions.

### Who can see my study data?
Study session data is strictly confidential. Parents and verified teachers can optionally be linked to accounts to view high-level progress reports (like time spent and mastery levels) but they cannot read granular chat logs—giving students a safe, judgment-free space to ask any question.
